title: Multiple-occupant load sign.
officialText:
When a space is occupied for multiple purposes involving different occupant loads the sign shall read as follows:

OCCUPANCY BY MORE THAN

(number) . . . . .PERSONS AS (type of occupancy) . . . OR BY (number) . . . . .PERSONS AS (type of occupancy) . . . OR BY (number) . . . . .PERSONS AS (type of occupancy) . . . IS DANGEROUS AND UNLAWFUL Certificate of Operation No . . . . . .

Commissioner, Dept. of Buildings, City of New York
